title: Astrid and the Hollow
author: Petra Ravensworth
blurb: Kestrel Eastwick, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
